February 22

Edgar W. Nye

By Marion F. Ham (1867–1956)

(Died Feb. 22, 1896)
N
O
 more the pleasing jest, the genial flow
Of mirth, the wit and wisdom haply wed;
With him all smiles have passed away, and so
The world shall laugh no more, since Nye is dead.
